<document id="SR-HEL-24-04" title="SGW Situation Report #4, Hurricane Helene, 2024-09-27 17:00 EDT" family="sitrep">
<passage n="00" section="Control box">
SGW Internal - Controlled                                                           SR-HEL-24-04

SGW
SGW Situation Report #4, Hurricane Helene, 2024-09-27 17:00 EDT
Date: 2024-09-27

SGW RESTRICTED - OPERATIONS

SGW Situation Report #4 | Friday, September 27, 2024 | 17:00 EDT

Incident: SGW-INC-24-0031 "HELENE" | Event Type 1 | Activation Level 1

DISTRIBUTION: EOC Command and General Staff; District Operations Managers; Water Branch;
Corporate Communications; Compliance

Prepared by: Planning Section, Situation Unit. Times are EDT unless marked Z (UTC).
</passage>
<passage n="01" section="EXECUTIVE SUMMARY">
EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

As of 16:30, about 1,388,000 SGW electric customers are without power, down from the system peak
of 1,612,400 at 09:15. As of 16:30, damage assessment has started on 61 percent of Aiken and
Richmond district feeders; Edgefield and Barnwell assessment begins at first light Saturday.

Water: pressure in the PS-17 Cedarfall zone fell below the 25 psi floor at 10:05Z after
FDR-AIK-2207 tripped at 05:30Z. Portable generator MGEN-HALBERD-500 was dispatched to PS-17 at
15:45Z and running at 18:15Z; zone pressure is recovering. Tallow Branch hospital
(HSP-AIK-TALLOWBRANCH) is on its own standby generator GEN-HSP-TALLOWBRANCH for power; its water
supply depends on PS-17. No global ETR has been released. Planning Section targets a first range
for Incident Commander review by 2024-09-28 12:00.
</passage>
<passage n="02" section="ELECTRIC">
ELECTRIC

+-------------------+--------------------+-----------+--------------------+--------------------+
| District          | Customers out (as  | Peak out  | Feeders locked out | Transmission lines |
|                   | of 16:30)          |           |                    | out                |
+===================+====================+===========+====================+====================+
| Aiken             | 214,600            | 241,300   | 87                 | 4                  |
| Richmond          | 196,200            | 228,900   | 71                 | 3                  |
| Columbia          | 402,700            | 451,800   | 133                | 6                  |
| (Richland)        |                    |           |                    |                    |
| Greenville        | 318,900            | 382,100   | 109                | 2                  |
| Charleston        | 255,600            | 308,300   | 64                 | 1                  |
| Total             | 1,388,000          | 1,612,400 | 464                | 16                 |
+-------------------+--------------------+-----------+--------------------+--------------------+

SUB-AIK-BRAMBLEGATE lost both 115 kV sources at 05:22Z; one source restored 19:40Z. FDR-AIK-2207
remains locked out pending trunk patrol (OP05 ICS 204, IAP-HEL-24-OP05/204-02). FDR-AIK-2214 and
FDR-AIK-2231 restored 20:05Z.
</passage>
<passage n="03" section="WATER">
WATER

As of 16:45, PS-17 Pellicott Road Booster is on MGEN-HALBERD-500. Zone WZ-PS17-CEDARFALL low
reading was 8.0 psi; readings are rising but remain under 25 psi. TNK-PS17-CEDARFALL level is
recovering after drawdown overnight. Water Compliance Officer and Water Incident Lead are
assessing a boil water notice for WZ-PS17-CEDARFALL; SCDES contact made 13:10. PS-38 Copperleaf
and PS-52 Deerwater are on site generators. Diesel to GEN-PS38-COPPERLEAF is scheduled;
Copperleaf Road open at 15:30 per F-MAL-030 log. PS-23 Laurel Spur on utility power; pump 1
low-suction alarm 15:31, Water Ops crew on site, inspection note to follow.
</passage>
<passage n="04" section="RESOURCES">
RESOURCES

+---------------------------------+------------------------------------------------------------+
| Resource                        | As of 16:00                                                |
+=================================+============================================================+
| SGW line crews                  | 412                                                        |
| Mutual-aid line crews on site   | 286                                                        |
| Mutual-aid crews en route (SEE) | 540                                                        |
| Vegetation crews                | 318                                                        |
| Staging yards open              | STG-AIK-SANDHILL-YARD, STG-RCH-MILLPOND-YARD,              |
|                                 | STG-RLD-CONGAREEBEND-YARD                                  |
+---------------------------------+------------------------------------------------------------+

Fuel: FTK-WREN-3 assigned to water facilities in Aiken district. Altamaha Fuel & Lube deliveries
under MAL-CTR-0447 running to plan.
</passage>
<passage n="05" section="SAFETY; NEXT REPORT">
SAFETY

No lost-time injuries reported this period. Two vehicle contacts with debris, no injuries.
Bucket work limited by wind until 13:00. Crews reminded: do not drive through water over a
roadway (GEP 2F.01 section 6.1).

NEXT REPORT

Situation Report #5: Saturday, September 28, 2024, 07:00 EDT.
</passage>
</document>
Write one header per passage, in passage order.
